status: Owner Decision — Ratified for Descriptive Atlas v0.1
governing_principle: One epistemic object should have one canonical citation identity, unless an independently governed derivative becomes a genuinely distinct epistemic object.

correction_semantics.knowledge_or_claim_error: correct in canonical source BC-* under SOURCE_AND_CLAIM_POLICY.md, then regenerate the Atlas
correction_semantics.derivation_or_distribution_error: fix the generator/derivation and regenerate, without changing the source claim

reconsideration_triggers: atlas record contains Altis-authored synthesis not present in BC
atlas record merges more than one source case into one object
atlas record has an independent lifecycle/version history
atlas record has an independent correction history
atlas record has an independent falsifier
an external citation need arises that a BC citation cannot represent precisely
atlas advances to a new authorized layer differing substantively from a derived descriptive view
